title: Bots are not the reason the economy is expensive

posts.cooked: Hot take: bots actually make the game cheaper by farming massive amounts of materials. If we didn't have bots farming herbs and ores 24/7, the prices of flasks and potions would be 5x higher because real players don't want to spend hours grinding low-level nodes. The expensive prices are due to Blizzard's high rarity node spawns and gold sinks, not the bots.
